title: The God Jehovah Reigns
description: The God Jehovah Reigns in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (1719): Psalm 99, part 1, headed “Christ's kingdom and majesty”.
Watts' psalms were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The God Je-ho-vah reigns, Let all the na-tions fear, Let sin-ners trem-ble at his throne, And saints be hum-ble there.

lines: Let sinners tremble at his throne,
His church shall make his wonders known,
Justice, and truth, and judgment join
In all his works of grace.

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated (1719)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
